programFocus: Helps individuals with disabilities build independent living, social, and job skills through community integration and supported work environments.
parentReviews: Reviewers praise the highly structured environment and the variety of social, educational, and entertaining activities provided.
The location is noted for having a fully trained, professional staff that helps clients maintain their independence and high quality of life.
Because it operates under the large Sevita/MENTOR corporate umbrella, some families note that the intake and administrative paperwork can feel highly bureaucratic.

programFocus: A site-based adult day program with a strong emphasis on behavior management, teaching social skills curriculums, and providing integration into supported work environments.
parentReviews: Client care is highly praised; reviewers note that the agency provides excellent, individualized care and that client needs are met in every area of their life.
The program is well-regarded for safely handling clients who require specialized behavioral management and structured routines.
Online employee reviews indicate high management turnover, which parents should note as it can occasionally impact daily staff consistency.

programFocus: Provides vocational resources and training for adults with developmental disabilities, focusing heavily on supervised work skills and local job placement.
parentReviews: Highly rated for its direct focus on vocational training; reviewers appreciate that clients are integrated into actual work environments (like warehouse tasks and fulfillment).
The program maintains strong corporate partnerships (e.g., e.l.f. beauty, GEODIS) to provide real-world, supervised employment opportunities.
Because the focus is heavily on repetitive, routine tasks for vocational training, it is best suited for individuals specifically looking for employment skills rather than purely social recreation.

address: 1737 Atlanta Avenue Unit H9, Riverside, CA 92507
programFocus: Provides comprehensive day services aimed at promoting independence, community involvement, and life skills development for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
parentReviews: Families feel highly secure working with a massive, trusted national brand that utilizes standardized care protocols and safety measures.
The center is praised for offering a wide variety of wrap-around services beyond just day care, including speech and physical therapies.
Due to the massive scale of the organization, the environment can feel very clinical, but the staff is highly trained in managing transitions.
